title: C6: public/private border and private follow lists (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16): (A) one-way border: public CORUNDUM content may be referenced in Agora by CID; no software writes Agora membership, Space names, channels or member lists into CORUNDUM public data; clients disclose that the identity is shared across both systems. PLUS: CORUNDUM follow lists become PRIVATE by default: stored encrypted, readable only by the user and their own operator (needed to build the feed); users may opt in to publishing all or part; new-follower notices are the follower's setting. Accepted loss: friends-of-friends discovery comes only from opted-in lists or curators.
notes: CORUNDUM 2026-10-18: follow lists private by default (JWE to listKey + operator key), publishable; but every follow ALWAYS sends a signed FollowNotification (not the follower's setting) because followers-only reply policies need it. Profile section 5 updated.
